reasons.image:
ipinfusion/ocnos/Makefile via the standard IMG_REPOSITORY=$(REGISTRY)$(IMG_VENDOR)_$(IMG_NAME)
rule (VENDOR=IPInfusion, NAME=OcNOS -> lowercased "ipinfusion_ocnos").
Version "6.5.2-101" is the version the vrnetlab README itself documents as
"Tested booting and responding to Telnet" (README's own real evidence).
reasons.min_ram_mb: README "System requirements": CPU 2 core, RAM <4GB, Disk <4GB.

settings.description: IP Infusion OcNOS via vrnetlab (containerized QEMU wrapper). OcNOS is a full-featured disaggregated NOS (routing/MPLS/switching) with no native netplex profile of any kind (no taxonomy tile, no device_profiles entry, no community-registry fallback).
